forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.none: No forecast yet; refresh the data to compute one.
forecast.whatIfBanner: You are looking at a what-if simulation. It is never stored as the official forecast.
forecast.moved: The forecast moved from {from} to {to} since {date}.
forecast.methodToggle: Forecasting method, with the actual numbers
forecast.methodText: The baseline is Holt linear exponential smoothing fitted on the published series since 2010 (a damped trend when fewer than five points exist). Accepted signals linked to this index shift the path within bounded caps (4/8/10 percent of the score range at +1/+3/+5 years), weighted by impact, horizon match, and age. A linked NDS3 target that states a rank pulls the path toward it, scaled by the target's status. A 5,000-run Monte Carlo (bootstrapped residuals, perturbed weights) gives the 10th/50th/90th percentiles, and ranks come from the latest distribution of other countries drifted by their own trends.
